question: I want to build an NFT collection and a tokenized vault as Stellar smart contracts. Which SEPs define them, and is there a library that implements them?

golden.answer: SEP-50 defines the non-fungible token contract interface, similar to ERC-721. SEP-56 defines the tokenized vault, the counterpart of ERC-4626: depositors receive SEP-41 share tokens over a SEP-41 underlying asset. As of 2026-11-14 both are Draft. OpenZeppelin's Stellar Contracts library implements both. SEP-39 separately gives guidance for NFTs issued as classic assets.
keyFacts: SEP-50 defines the non-fungible token contract interface.
SEP-56 defines the tokenized vault standard for Soroban contracts.
Reports each SEP's status with a date.
OpenZeppelin's Stellar Contracts library implements both standards.
avoid: Do NOT say SEP-39 defines the smart contract NFT interface.
golden.notes: Both SEPs were Draft on 2026-11-14. Accept a later dated status.

sources.quote: SEP: 0050 Title: Non-Fungible Tokens ... Status: Draft ... The interface is a similar to ERC721
SEP: 0056 Title: Tokenized Vault Standard ... Status: Draft ... The vault itself must also comply with SEP-41 and further extend it.
This SEP provides informational guidelines on how NFTs can be managed on the Stellar network and within the ecosystem.
The Fungible Token Vault extends the Fungible Token and implements SEP-56 Tokenized Vault Standard

corroboration.claim: SEP-50 is the non-fungible token contract interface and SEP-56 is the tokenized vault standard.

evidence.note: Preamble title 'Non-Fungible Tokens'; summary defines a standard contract interface for non-fungible tokens.
Preamble title 'Tokenized Vault Standard'; shares and underlying asset must be SEP-41 compliant.
Audited modules list names Non-Fungible Token and a Token Vault implementing SEP-56.

corroboration.claim: SEP-50 and SEP-56 both had Status: Draft on 2026-11-14.

evidence.note: Indexed SEP-0050 and SEP-0056 preambles both show Status: Draft.

corroboration.claim: OpenZeppelin's Stellar Contracts library implements both SEP-50 and SEP-56.

evidence.note: packages/tokens/src holds non_fungible and vault modules; latest release v0.8.0 (2026-10-20).
Lists Non-Fungible Token and Token Vault (SEP-56) among audited modules.

corroboration.claim: SEP-39 is informational guidance for NFTs issued as classic assets, not a contract interface.

evidence.note: Title 'Interoperability Recommendations for NFTs'; extends the SEP-1 currency specification.
Motivation contrasts contract NFTs with classic assets 'as outlined in SEP-39'.
